mapper.insert: insert into ai_knowledge_doc (module, doc_name, file_type, file_path, status, chunk_count, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{module}, #{docName}, #{fileType}, #{filePath}, #{status}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

mapper.insert: insert into ai_knowledge_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, create_time) values (#{docId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{embedding}, sysdate())
mapper.select:
select c.chunk_id as chunkId, c.doc_id as docId, c.chunk_index as chunkIndex, c.content as content, d.doc_name as docName, d.module as module from ai_knowledge_chunk c inner join ai_knowledge_doc d on d.doc_id = c.doc_id where d.status = '0'
and (d.module = #{module} or d.module = 'platform')

select c.chunk_id as chunkId, c.doc_id as docId, c.chunk_index as chunkIndex, c.content as content, c.embedding as embedding, d.doc_name as docName, d.module as module from ai_knowledge_chunk c inner join ai_knowledge_doc d on d.doc_id = c.doc_id where d.status = '0' and c.embedding is not null
